title: Connors three-day lower highs and lows pullback in 200-day uptrend

source.title: Larry Connors 3 Day High/Low Strategy (TradingView open-source script description)

rule_summary: All signals from closed daily candles (UTC) built from 1h data, executed at the next 1h open. ENTRY on a daily close when ALL hold: close > SMA(200 days); close < SMA(5 days); the day's high and low are both lower than the prior day's high and low, AND the prior day's high and low are both lower than those of the day before that (three consecutive days of lower highs and lower lows); no open position. EXIT on the first daily close above SMA(5 days). Protective stop: daily close 10% below entry price (checked on closed daily bars). Long only, one position, whole balance. Different from the repo's RSI(2) dip rule: trigger is a price-structure pattern, not an oscillator.
mechanism: Three straight days of lower highs and lower lows in an uptrend signals short-term over-extension by sellers and dip chasers; once selling is exhausted, price snaps back to its short mean and the patient buyer is paid by those who sold the low. Source gives no mechanism beyond short-term mean reversion in an uptrend.
